[project]
name = "ledgerline"
version = "2026.9.1"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["flask>=3.0", "structlog>=24.1", "requests>=2.32"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]

Tests use pytest and run through the `Makefile`:

- **`make test-fast`** runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`. This is the fast run: it skips tests marked `postgres`, so you don't need a database running. This is the recommended way to run the tests.
- **`make test`** runs `pytest -q`. This is the full suite, including the Postgres tests, so you'll need a Postgres instance available.

If you haven't installed the dev dependencies yet, run this first:

```sh
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

You can also call pytest directly on a single file or test, for example `pytest tests/test_foo.py -k some_name`.
